title: Electronic properties of the Radium-monochalcogenides RaX (X = O,S,Se) and RaO+/- ions
summary: We present a theoretical investigation on the electronic structure and properties of radium monochalcogenides, with chalcogens O, S, and Se, as well as the ionic species RaO +/-. Our approach combines fully relativistic and partially relativistic quantum-chemistry methods.
